verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order: the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow sits below the floating dark logo panel, left of the headline, and the divider rule is stranded above it. The headline is wrapped into a heavy three-line column. The body copy and CTA are pushed against the right edge, and the legal text is crammed and unreadable. B uses a clean full-height brand panel and keeps the original's centred stack in order (eyebrow, headline, rule, body, CTA, legal), with clear hierarchy and on-brand colours. It is only slightly tight vertically, and the legal text is very small.
